result.reason: The revision removes Licensor’s unilateral seven-year renewal right and requires mutual written agreement for 12-month renewals, while capping renewal increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%, thereby reaching the preferred position. It leaves unrelated termination and payment provisions intact and makes only targeted renewal changes. Drafting quality is reduced by retained defects and redundancy in Sections II and III—particularly “mutual written of the parties”—and by the lack of a defined CPI measure, though these issues do not defeat compliance.
